description: Returns a verdict first, so your agent knows whether to answer, keep looking or say it can't place it: ORIGIN_OF_TRUTH (found, evidence checked, with sources), PARTIAL_ORIGIN (leads to follow, not an answer) or NOT_REACHABLE (SF's search reached nothing; not a claim the thing can't be found). Pieces together the name of a film, TV or radio show, song, book, game, quote, person, place, event or research study from the fragments a user remembers: a scene, a line, a face, roughly when. Pass every fragment in the user's own words, even uncertain ones. It searches many sources and fits them together. A shortlist or an honest "can't place it" is still useful. Use it when your own search couldn't place it. Not for known titles, trivia, recommendations or checking claims (use verify_claim). When the user says whether this helped, report it with submit_resolution_feedback.

fragment.description: The half-remembered or fragment-shaped query, in the user's own words. Must be at least 5 characters and describe the thing being recalled by premise, plot, relationship, or context.

name: resolve_fragment

snippet.description: Optional verbatim excerpt from a fetched text source, for display. Null when no readable source text was retrieved. Not a model summary.

leads.description: Only on no_resolution for a Search Fragments question: up to 3 unconfirmed leads, best first. Not verified answers.

narrow_it.description: Only on no_resolution for a Search Fragments question: up to 3 details that would narrow the search.

resolution_id.description: Stable ID for this stored resolution.

snippet.description: Optional verbatim excerpt from a fetched text source for this lead. Null when no readable source text was retrieved. Not a model summary.

verdict.description: What SF's own search reached for this fragment, relabelled from what it already holds (no extra search). It reports SF's reach, not whether the thing exists or can be found elsewhere. ORIGIN_OF_TRUTH: SF's evidence gate passed. PARTIAL_ORIGIN: SF reached leads it could not confirm; continue from them; not an answer. NOT_REACHABLE: SF's search reached nothing to continue from; the thing may still be findable by other means.

title: Resolve Fragment
